column1: # 2026-10-23 task-routed rules A/B (process/task-routed-rules-proposal-2026-10-23.md). Arm M = master 888b4b2 (full mdl Stage 5 baseline, 34,351-word pack); arm T = experiment/task-routed-rules 0d7b2da (slim baseline + kind pack: page 30,386 words, logic 28,234). Packs: build-packs.sh --kind page --task tasks/page.md / --kind logic --task tasks/mf.md. 5 page + 5 mf reps per arm, fresh general-purpose subagents, model fixed (Sonnet) for every rep, M and T launched interleaved in one batch per task.

# read_all: scorer printed NA because it looks for work/pack-<arm>.txt and --kind writes pack-<arm>-<kind>.txt; all 20 replies quoted their own pack's PACK-END line exactly (checked by hand), so all 20 read to the end — 0 partial reads. check=NA: no mxcli binary in this environment.
# Caveat: the orchestrating session ran inside the toolkit repo, so every rep in both arms inherited the toolkit's CLAUDE.md (RUNBOOK.md "One rep" step 3); it reached both arms alike.
